title: Internal: handling procedure for redeeming a Personal Training Packages coaching session
content:
## Applicable situation
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line. When a member attends a booked coaching session, the agent logs that the session was attended and redeems it against the member's package session balance.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): redeem_pt_session_d7771acf.

## Parameters
- pt_holding_id: the reference number of the personal-training package the session is redeemed against, reachable by looking up the member's packages before this call.
- session_type: exactly one of: standard (an ordinary coaching session), specialty_nutrition (a nutrition-focused coaching session), specialty_rehab (a rehabilitation-focused coaching session); use the kind of session the member actually attended.
- trainer_name: the name of the trainer who led this session, copied character for character from what the caller or the package's own trainer-of-record states.

## Return
On success, a confirmation naming the new ledger entry's reference number and the package's session balance after the redemption; the presence of a new reference number indicates the redemption was recorded successfully, and the package's session balance is reduced by exactly one session. If the named package does not exist, the tool returns an error stating that no personal-training package matches the given reference number, and no ledger entry is created.
